structured.answer: After 8 years, with 500 ₪ a month, the calculator shows about 63,726 ₪ "נשאר בידיים". For 4 years it gives no number for a self-employed person, only a note that you pay tax if you take it out before 6 years.

stuck.where: Calculator result with the slider on 4 years
stuck.why: The fund bars for years 1-5 are empty dashed boxes, and the orange text says there's no calculation yet for self-employed people. The only number on screen, 25,725, is for 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך', so I had no answer for 4 years.
Not sure it means my normal monthly income. I put 9,500 anyway.

used: Intro line 'אחרי 6 שנים ... אפשר למשוך ... בלי מס'
Orange note 'לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים'
Bars: 48,000 הפקדתם, +5,309 החזר המס, +10,417 התשואה, 0 המס, 63,726 נשאר בידיים
skimmed: Line '13,783 ₪ בשנה ... גם הם יקבלו פטור'
skipped: Tabs 'שווה לדעת' and 'מי מציע ומי מצטרף'
Return and fee fields (left at defaults)
not_found: Any amount for withdrawing after 4 years as a self-employed person

findings.what: There's no result for withdrawing before 6 years as a self-employed person. Half of what I came to check is missing.
On the 4-year view, the only big number (25,725) belongs to the securities-account comparison, so it's easy to take it as the fund amount.
55,471 for the securities account sits right next to the 63,726 result and looks almost the same, with its label at the far left edge.
'הכנסה חייבת' is jargon, so I wasn't sure what to type.
